ayahOccurrences.text: يَتَجَرَّعُهُۥ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُسِيغُهُۥ وَيَأْتِيهِ ٱلْمَوْتُ مِن كُلِّ مَكَانٍ وَمَا هُوَ بِمَيِّتٍ ۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِۦ عَذَابٌ غَلِيظٌ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: يَتَجَرَّعُهُۥ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُسِيغُهُۥ وَيَأْتِيهِ ٱلْمَوْتُ مِن كُلِّ مَكَانٍ وَمَا هُوَ بِمَيِّتٍ ۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِۦ عَذَابٌ غَلِيظٌ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person masculine singular (form V) imperfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: يَتَجَرَّعُهُۥ is in the derivative form: يَتَجَرَّعُ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ج/ر/ع   j–r–ʿ barren land that does not hold water; to drink, to sip, to gulp down, a mouthful of drink. Of this root, يَتَجَرَّعُ yatajarraʿ occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
يَتَجَرَّعُ yatajarraʿ [imperf. of v. V, trans.] to make oneself drink, or gulp down, particularly something unpleasant, in small amounts or one after the other

(14:17) يَتَجَرَّعُهُ وَلاَ يَكَادُ يُسِيغُهُ he [forces himself to] gulp it down, although scarcely able to swallow it.
